# ANALYSIS: ShotgunScalperStage3TopKeeper

**Filed:** 2026-07-12  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)

## Hypothesis

The combo seeks to improve edge capture by tightening the premium-based stop (-0.35) and take-profit (1.5%) while using a short time stop (15 min) and ITM-2 strikes (strike_offset=2). The hypothesis is that a tighter stop reduces loser magnitude, and the chandelier arm (0.5%) locks early gains, thereby increasing net edge on J's winner days without excessively adding to loser days.

## Mechanism

Entry logic remains identical to the baseline shotgun_scalper_stage2 (presumed VWAP continuation or similar). Exit rules:  
- Take profit when premium ≥ entry × 1.5  
- Stop loss when premium ≤ entry × (1 - 0.35) = entry × 0.65  
- Time stop after 15 minutes if neither TP nor SL hit  
- Strike selection: ITM-2 (strike_offset=2)  
- Chandelier profit-lock arms at +0.5% premium and trails 15% off the high-water mark  
- Volume ratio threshold set to 1.0 (no volume filter)
